items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I would be listening to jazz records, Louis Armstrong records, trying to copy them

ctx.x: Oh, I see. Yeah. Nothing doing, and he'd tell you to get your horn out.

Yeah. So if he would give me a lesson to take home to learn, I would be listening to jazz records, Louis Armstrong records, trying to copy them, and wouldn't pay the lesson no mind. And when I'd come back for him to go over the lesson with me -- when he got ready to go over the lesson with me, I wouldn't know none of it. And by the time he started hitting me on my head --
